contextual scene read / action / save / skip

protected_invariants: optional R01-R13 content remains available but skippable
transformation_ledger.exact_delta: Remove READ as a top-level bottom-nav destination; preserve R01-R13 content through contextual entry from TODAY nearby scenes and ROUTE/imprint dialogs, with deep-read access inside the dialog or post-route detail.
transformation_ledger.resulting_configuration: TODAY / ROUTE / MY BOOK as primary exploration surfaces; SERVICE/RETURN remains parallel; optional reading becomes context-first rather than library-first.
transformation_ledger.causal_change: Content discovery shifts from a dedicated library surface toward scene/route-triggered contextual reveal.

hypothesized_value_or_design_consequence.benefit: reduces top-level digital attention and reinforces 'visit first, read when relevant'
hypothesized_value_or_design_consequence.risk: deep-read library becomes less discoverable for users who want to browse content independent of route

new_dependencies: deep-read discoverability depends more strongly on scene/context entry points
removed_dependencies: top-level READ tab as independent content-library entry
unknowns: whether independent browse is a material user need
failure_conditions: users cannot intentionally browse deeper content without being at/choosing a scene
contextual entry makes source/deep-read content harder to find
removal causes content to become route-owned rather than optional
transformation_ledger.artifact_required: matched IA schematic + future interactive prototype if decision is reopened

transformation_ledger.exact_delta: Create a separate dedicated RETURN bottom-nav surface while also retaining ROUTE return mode and SERVICE/RETURN header access.
transformation_ledger.resulting_configuration: ROUTE and RETURN become independent top-level surfaces with overlapping direction/status content.
transformation_ledger.causal_change: Return gains a dedicated navigation destination but duplicates route/service truth surfaces.

hypothesized_value_or_design_consequence.risk: three partially overlapping return authorities create divergence and maintenance burden

unknowns: whether visual prominence improves actual recovery
failure_conditions: service status updates only one surface
user cannot distinguish route exploration from return truth

transformation_ledger.exact_delta: Force content intensity from reality state: NORMAL→FULL; DEGRADED→LIGHT; CLOSED/UNKNOWN→OFF.
transformation_ledger.resulting_configuration: One combined state mapping replaces two independent axes.
transformation_ledger.causal_change: content intensity becomes a function of route/reality state.

hypothesized_value_or_design_consequence.risk: collapses independent dimensions and falsely implies content availability from field/reality state

failure_conditions: UNKNOWN is treated as sufficient authority to infer every content state
offline/content availability becomes conflated with field condition

transformation_ledger.exact_delta: Let the ROUTE map also express a dedicated RETURN purpose mode while retaining its journey/culture/rest purposes.
transformation_ledger.resulting_configuration: one map carrier presents several purpose views; return is a mode, not a duplicated map truth source.
transformation_ledger.causal_change: ROUTE gains a second role: exploration map + return-oriented relation view.

hypothesized_value_or_design_consequence.benefit: supports return without creating a second route authority

new_dependencies: mode-specific overlay depends on same underlying relational map
removed_dependencies: need for a second independent return map surface

transformation_ledger.exact_delta: Break any requirement that route/return or journey completion depends on completing R01-R13 content or collecting all items.
transformation_ledger.resulting_configuration: content remains optional/open-order; route/return stays continuously available.
transformation_ledger.causal_change: journey truth is decoupled from gamified content completion.

hypothesized_value_or_design_consequence.benefit: preserves real landscape primacy and safe exit/return
hypothesized_value_or_design_consequence.risk: none created by this replay; already Current

failure_conditions: any later gamification reintroduces route/return gating

transformed_candidate_ledger.note: Dedicated READ remains available while contextual scene access also exists.

transformed_candidate_ledger.primary_structural_delta: remove top-level READ and route all optional reading through contextual scene entry
transformed_candidate_ledger.falsifier: deep-read/browse discoverability becomes materially worse or content becomes route-owned rather than optional
transformed_candidate_ledger.required_next_test_if_reopened: matched interactive prototype + representative-user HCD test

rejected_transformation_ledger.reason: Duplicates route/return truth surfaces and creates synchronization/common-maintenance risk without enough evidence of benefit.
Violates explicit Current invariant that reality state and content intensity are independent axes.

baseline_reconstruction.finding: Current ROUTE return-purpose mode is a legitimate role-reassignment pattern because it reuses one map authority rather than duplicating truth.
Current no-completion-gate rule is a dependency-breaking pattern that protects return/safety and non-gamified journey logic.

matched_artifact_requirement.rule: Compare Current and CTR-A at the same IA/state schematic fidelity; rejected transformations are shown only to expose why they fail.

rationale: The replay is retrospective and non-blind, so it cannot independently reselect Current.
CTR-A is a real IA family difference because top-level content-library access is removed and contextual entry becomes primary.
CTR-02 demonstrates that duplication can worsen truth authority even when visual prominence improves.
CTR-03 demonstrates that a new dependency can be invalid because it collapses two explicitly independent state axes.
CTR-04/05 reconstruct existing Current design moves and are therefore not counted as alternatives.

method_findings: The technique pack can generate a material alternative from an existing mature baseline without reopening field or route authority.
Operator use does not imply candidate retention; protected-invariant attacks rejected two transformations.
Existing Current moves can be recognized as transformation patterns without being double-counted as new concepts.
External context and state variables remain authority-bound rather than free ideation resources.
Idea/operator count is not used as option-space quality.
claim_ceiling: RETROSPECTIVE DESIGN-METHOD REPLAY / ONE DIGITAL OBJECT / CURRENT NOT REOPENED / HCD + RUNTIME + FIELD EVIDENCE OPEN / NO PROMOTION
